text:
He invented himself a face.
+
+Behind it
+
+he lived, died, and rose again
+
+many times.
+
+His face
+
+today bears that face’s wrinkles.
+
+His wrinkles have no face.

translation.title: The Other
translation.editorial_note: The repetitions of face and wrinkles remain unsmoothed, allowing persona, aging, and facelessness to undo one another line by line.
